title: Two-level NAND identity for tribes
statement: For every $x\in\{-1,1\}^4$, apply the two-input operation that returns $1$ exactly when both entries are $-1$, and $-1$ otherwise, first to each of the two coordinate pairs and then to those two outputs. The result is $1$ exactly when each coordinate pair contains at least one $1$, and is $-1$ otherwise.
